ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
FOR CCW PERMIT HOLDERS
In addition to completing the requirements within the application, you must also satisfy
the training requirement specified in Penal Code Section 12050(E)(i) For new license
applicants, the course of training may be any course acceptable to the licensing
authority, shall not exceed 16 hours, and shall include instruction on at least firearm
safety and the law regarding the permissible use of a firearm. For your information, this
is a new requirement. Also, there is a 4-hour refresher course required prior to renewing
your permit every two years.
